-- House color cycle. Each server update repaints hundreds of parts for everyone, so the server
-- only gets a step every 0.6s; your own screen is smoothed below.
task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        if Settings.houseRainbow and HouseNumber.Value > 0 then
            local color = houseColorAt(os.clock() + 0.05)
            setHouseColor(color)
            table.insert(housePaint.recent, 1, color)
            housePaint.recent[4] = nil
            if os.clock() >= housePaint.refreshAt then
                housePaint.refreshAt = os.clock() + 8
                task.delay(0.8, function()
                    if alive then
                        housePaint.parts = collectHouseParts()
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.6)
        else
            table.clear(housePaint.parts)
            housePaint.refreshAt = 0
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

do
    -- Repaint 20 times a second, and also immediately in any frame where a server update just
    -- landed (the first part no longer shows what we last wrote), so it never flickers.
    local nextFrame = 0
    local lastWritten
    bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        local parts = housePaint.parts
        if not Settings.houseRainbow or HouseNumber.Value <= 0 or #parts == 0 then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local overwritten = lastWritten ~= nil and parts[1].Color ~= lastWritten
        if now < nextFrame and not overwritten then return end
        nextFrame = now + 0.05
        local color = houseColorAt(now)
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            part.Color = color
        end
        lastWritten = parts[1].Color
    end)
end

-- RGB streaming. The server gets ~10 small steps a second (tested: 28/28 accepted at this
-- rate), sent without waiting on each reply, so other players see a smooth fade too.
-- Three refusals in a row (e.g. a car that can't be painted) switch the feature off.
local RGB_SEND_INTERVAL = 0.1
local RGB_MAX_IN_FLIGHT = 2

-- getTarget returns what to recolor right now, or nil to pause.
local function rgbStream(getTarget, send, onFail)
    task.spawn(function()
        local inFlight, failures = 0, 0
        while alive do
            local target = getTarget()
            if target and inFlight < RGB_MAX_IN_FLIGHT then
                inFlight += 1
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, msg = send(target, os.clock() + RGB_SEND_INTERVAL)
                    inFlight -= 1
                    if ok or getTarget() ~= target then
                        failures = 0
                    else
                        failures += 1
                        if failures >= 3 then
                            failures = 0
                            onFail(msg)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(target and RGB_SEND_INTERVAL or 0.25)
        end
    end)
end

-- Car RGB keeps going whether you're driving the car or it's parked (the game accepts paint
-- for your car from anywhere). While you drive, it waits for auto-tune to finish first.
local function rgbCar()
    if not Settings.carRGB then return nil end
    local s = Session
    if s and not s.ready then return nil end
    return ownCar()
end

rgbStream(rgbCar, function(car, t)
    return paintCar(car, rgbColor(Settings.rgbMode, t, Settings.rgbCycle))
end, function(msg)
    setCarRGB(false)
    notify("Car RGB", "Stopped: " .. tostring(msg), "bad")
end)

-- The underglow request has no car id, so it only works for the car you're in.
rgbStream(function()
    local s = Session
    return Settings.rainbowGlow and s and s.ready and s or nil
end, function(_, t)
    local ok, msg = carRequest("SetUnderglowColor", 1, glowColor(t))
    -- Usually the glow is just switched off; turn the chosen style back on and keep going.
    if not ok and tostring(msg):lower():find("select an underglow") then
        carRequest("SetUnderglow", Settings.underglow)
    end
    return ok, msg
end, function(msg)
    Settings.rainbowGlow = false
    saveSoon()
    refreshModule("RGB Underglow")
    notify("RGB Underglow", "Stopped: " .. tostring(msg), "bad")
end)

-- Your own screen: recolor every frame so the fade is perfectly smooth between the server's
-- steps (replicated values land before RenderStepped, so these always win on screen).
bind(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
    local t = os.clock()
    local car = rgbCar()
    if car then
        local color = rgbColor(Settings.rgbMode, t, Settings.rgbCycle)
        for _, part in ipairs(paintParts(car)) do
            part.Color = color
        end
    end
    local s = Session
    if not s or not s.ready then return end
    if Settings.rainbowGlow then
        local color = glowColor(t)
        for _, obj in ipairs(glowObjects(s.car)) do
            if obj:IsA("Beam") then
                obj.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
            else
                obj.Color = color
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Rainbow RP name. Brookhaven waits 1s between name color changes, so match that.
task.spawn(function()
    local hue = 0
    while alive do
        if Settings.rainbowName then
            hue = (hue + 0.08) % 1
            NameColorEvent:FireServer("PickingRPNameColor", Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1))
            task.wait(1.1)
        else
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

-- Auto Flip: if the car stays on its roof or side for a moment, ask the game to set it upright.
task.spawn(function()
    local tippedSince
    local lastFlip = 0
    while alive do
        local s = Session
        if Settings.autoFlip and s and not s.stunting and s.geom then
            local up = carFrame(s).UpVector
            if up.Y < 0.35 then
                tippedSince = tippedSince or os.clock()
                if os.clock() - tippedSince > 1.2 and os.clock() - lastFlip > 5 then
                    lastFlip = os.clock()
                    tippedSince = nil
                    local ok = carRequest("RepositionVehicle")
                    notify("Auto Flip", ok and "Back on your wheels" or "Couldn't flip the car", ok and "good" or "bad")
                end
            else
                tippedSince = nil
            end
        else
            tippedSince = nil
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

-- Air Stunts and Landing Assist watch every physics step.
bind(RunService.Heartbeat, airMonitor)

-- Auto Headlights. The game only reports the light state when it's toggled, so this switches
-- at dusk and dawn (and when you get in) and checks the answer; pressing V yourself still works
-- in between.
task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        local s = Session
        if Settings.autoLights and s and s.ready then
            local clock = savedLighting and savedLighting.ClockTime or Lighting.ClockTime
            local night = clock < 6.3 or clock >= 17.7
            if s.lightsFor ~= night then
                s.lightsFor = night
                if s.lightsOn == nil and not night then
                    s.lightsOn = false -- a freshly spawned car has its lights off
                end
                for _ = 1, 2 do
                    if s.lightsOn == night or Session ~= s then break end
                    local called, state = invoke("ToggleHeadLights")
                    if not called or type(state) ~= "boolean" then
                        notify("Auto Headlights", "Couldn't switch the lights: " .. tostring(state), "bad")
                        break
                    end
                    s.lightsOn = state
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

-- Periodic refresh for things that change on their own.
task.spawn(function()
    local tick = 0
    while alive do
        tick += 1
        if tick % 10 == 0 then
            refreshVehicleStatus()
            for _, name in ipairs({ "Fire", "Engine Smoke" }) do
                refreshModule(name)
            end
        end
        -- Brookhaven's HUD changes with what you're doing, so re-measure it every few seconds.
        if tick % 50 == 1 then
            placeArrayList()
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

local function getHRP()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getHumanoid()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local DIRECTIONS = {
    Left = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
    Right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
    Forwards = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
    Backwards = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
    Up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
    Down = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
}

local function getCF(part, isFor)
    local cframe = part.CFrame
    local noRot = CFrame.new(cframe.p)
    local x, y, z = (Camera.CFrame - Camera.CFrame.p):toEulerAnglesXYZ()
    return noRot * CFrame.Angles(isFor and z or x, y, z)
end

local function getNextMovement(deltaTime, spd)
    local nextMove = Vector3.new()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not humanoid or not hrp then return CFrame.new(), nextMove end

    local md = humanoid.MoveDirection

    for dirName, vector in pairs(DIRECTIONS) do
        local isFor = (dirName == "Forwards" or dirName == "Backwards")
        local worldVector = ((getCF(hrp, isFor) * CFrame.new(vector)) - hrp.CFrame.p).p
        if (worldVector - md).magnitude <= 1.05 and md ~= Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
            nextMove = nextMove + vector
        end
    end

    if upPressed then nextMove = nextMove + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if downPressed then nextMove = nextMove + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end

    return CFrame.new(nextMove * spd * deltaTime), nextMove
end

local function applySitAnim(humanoid)
    if not humanoid then return end
    humanoid.Sit = true
    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
end

local function removeSitAnim(humanoid)
    if not humanoid then return end
    humanoid.Sit = false
end

local function startFly()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    flying = true
    tiltAmount = 0

    flyForce = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    flyForce.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    flyForce.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, FLY_HEIGHT_OFFSET, 0)
    flyForce.Name = "HDAdminFlyForce"
    flyForce.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.D = 50
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 200
    bodyGyro.Name = "HDAdminFlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    if flyMode == 2 then
        applySitAnim(humanoid)
    end

    local lastUpdate = tick()
    local lastPosition = hrp.Position
    local static = 0

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying then return end

        local currentHrp = getHRP()
        local currentHumanoid = getHumanoid()
        if not currentHrp or not currentHumanoid then return end

        local delta = tick() - lastUpdate
        local look = (Camera.Focus.p - Camera.CFrame.p).unit
        local move, directionalVector = getNextMovement(delta, speed * 10)

        local pos = currentHrp.Position
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(pos, pos + look) * move
        local targetD = 750 + (speed * 0.2)

        if move.p ~= Vector3.new() then
            static = 0
            flyForce.D = targetD
            tiltAmount = tiltAmount + TILT_INCREMENT
            flyForce.Position = targetCFrame.p
        else
            static = static + 1
            tiltAmount = 1
            local mag = (currentHrp.Position - lastPosition).magnitude
            if mag > 6 and static >= 4 then
                flyForce.Position = currentHrp.Position
            end
        end

        if math.abs(tiltAmount) > TILT_MAX then
            tiltAmount = TILT_MAX
        end

        if flyForce.D == targetD then
            local tiltZ = tiltAmount * directionalVector.Z
            bodyGyro.CFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tiltZ), 0, 0)
        end

        lastUpdate = tick()
        lastPosition = currentHrp.Position

        if flyMode == 2 then
            if not currentHumanoid.Sit then
                currentHumanoid.Sit = true
            end
            currentHumanoid.PlatformStand = false
        else
            currentHumanoid.PlatformStand = true
            currentHumanoid.Sit = false
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if flyForce then flyForce:Destroy(); flyForce = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy(); bodyGyro = nil end

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        humanoid.Sit = false
        removeSitAnim(humanoid)
    end

    upPressed = false
    downPressed = false
end

local C = {

	aimKey = Enum.KeyCode.E,
	gainFar = 0.28,

	smooth = 0.42,

}

-- smooth switch state

local nextSwitchAt = 0

local function parts()
	local out = {}
	local maps = workspace:FindFirstChild("Maps")
	if not maps then
		return out
	end
	for _, mf in ipairs(maps:GetChildren()) do
		local tf = mf:FindFirstChild("Targets")
		if tf then
			for _, t in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
				local p = t:FindFirstChild("Primary")
				if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(out, p)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function closest(list)
	local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		local sp, on = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p.Position)
		if on and sp.Z > 0 then
			local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
			if d < bestD then
				bestD, best = d, p
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestD
end

-- config save
local function serialize()
	local t = {}
	for k, v in pairs(C) do
		if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" then
			t[k] = { __enum = tostring(v.EnumType), name = v.Name }
		else
			t[k] = v
		end
	end
	return HttpService:JSONEncode(t)
end

local function applyConfig(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for k, v in pairs(data) do
		if C[k] ~= nil then
			if type(v) == "table" and v.__enum and v.name then
				local ok, ev = pcall(function()
					return Enum[v.__enum][v.name]
				end)
				if ok and ev then
					C[k] = ev
				end
			else
				C[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	activeSmooth = C.smooth
end

local function saveConfig()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if writefile then
			writefile(CONFIG_FILE, serialize())
		else
			G.__AimConfigSave = serialize()
		end
	end)
	if ok then
		print("config saved")
	else
		warn("ave failed:", err)
	end
end

local function loadConfig()
	local ok, raw = pcall(function()
		if isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) and readfile then
			return readfile(CONFIG_FILE)
		elseif G.__AimConfigSave then
			return G.__AimConfigSave
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if not ok or not raw or raw == "" then
		print("no config found")
		return false
	end
	local ok2, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
	end)
	if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" then
		warn("config corrupt")
		return false
	end
	applyConfig(data)
	print("config loaded")
	return true
end

local function startAim()
	if not C.enabled then
		return
	end
	aiming = true
	accX, accY = 0, 0
	stepX, stepY = 0, 0
	startT = os.clock()
	phase = math.random() * 100
	doOvershoot = math.random() < C.overshootChance
	overshootDone = false
	lastTarget = nil
	stopUntil = 0
	wiggleX, wiggleY = 0, 0
	trigStart = os.clock()
	activeSmooth = C.smoothSwitch and C.smoothA or C.smooth
	nextSwitchAt = os.clock() + C.switchMin + math.random() * math.max(C.switchMax - C.switchMin, 0)
	lastSmoothIdx = 1
end

local function stopAim()
	aiming = false
	accX, accY = 0, 0
	stepX, stepY = 0, 0
	lastTarget = nil
	if trigHolding then
		mouseUp()
		trigHolding = false
	end
end

local function pickRandomSmooth()
	local vals = { C.smoothA, C.smoothB, C.smoothC }
	-- random index, prefer not same as last (but allow if only one)
	local idx = math.random(1, 3)
	if idx == lastSmoothIdx then
		idx = (idx % 3) + 1
		-- 50% chance still allow same for true randomness
		if math.random() < 0.5 then
			idx = math.random(1, 3)
		end
	end
	lastSmoothIdx = idx
	return vals[idx], idx
end

		fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
	end
	refresh()
	sliderRefresh[key] = refresh

	local dragging = false
	local function setFromX(x)
		local rel = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		C[key] = minV + (maxV - minV) * rel
		refresh()
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
	track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end))

track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local want = C.enabled and UIS:IsKeyDown(C.aimKey)
	if want and not aiming then
		startAim()
	elseif not want and aiming then
		stopAim()
	end

	dt = math.clamp(dt, 1 / 240, 1 / 20)
	local now = os.clock()
	local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
	local plist = parts()
	local target, dist = closest(plist)
	dist = dist or math.huge

	-- random smoothness switch (not sequential)
	if C.smoothSwitch and aiming and now >= nextSwitchAt then
		local val = pickRandomSmooth()
		activeSmooth = val
		local span = math.max(C.switchMax - C.switchMin, 0.05)
		nextSwitchAt = now + C.switchMin + math.random() * span
	elseif not C.smoothSwitch then
		activeSmooth = C.smooth
	end

	if aiming and now - startT >= C.reaction and target then
		if now < stopUntil then
			stepX, stepY = stepX * 0.3, stepY * 0.3
		elseif math.random() < C.stopChance then
			stopUntil = now + C.stopDuration * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
		end

		if target ~= lastTarget then
			lastTarget = target
			doOvershoot = math.random() < C.overshootChance
			overshootDone = false
			phase = math.random() * 100
		end

		local sp, on = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.Position)
		if on and sp.Z > 0 then
			local dx = sp.X - center.X
			local dy = sp.Y - center.Y
			dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

			local t = now - startT
			local ws = C.wiggleSpeed
			local w = C.wiggle
			local targetWX = (math.sin(t * ws + phase)
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 0.37 + phase * 2.1) * 0.55
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 1.7 + phase * 0.5) * 0.25) * w
			local targetWY = (math.cos(t * ws * 0.9 + phase * 1.3)
				+ math.sin(t * ws * 0.51 + phase * 0.7) * 0.55
				+ math.cos(t * ws * 1.4 + phase) * 0.25) * w
			wiggleX = wiggleX + (targetWX - wiggleX) * math.clamp(dt * 8, 0, 1)
			wiggleY = wiggleY + (targetWY - wiggleY) * math.clamp(dt * 8, 0, 1)

			local blend = math.clamp(1 - (dist / math.max(C.closePx, 1)), 0, 1)
			blend = blend * blend
			local gain = C.gainFar + (C.gainClose - C.gainFar) * blend

			if doOvershoot and not overshootDone and dist >= C.overshootMin then
				gain = gain * C.overshootScale
				if dist < C.overshootMin * 0.6 then
					overshootDone = true
				end
			end

			if dist <= C.curveRadius then
				gain = math.min(gain, C.gainClose * 0.85)
			end

			local sUse = activeSmooth
			local gainCap = 0.9 + math.clamp(sUse - 1, 0, 1) * 0.08
			gain = math.clamp(gain, 0.05, gainCap)

			local desiredX = (dx + wiggleX) * gain
			local desiredY = (dy + wiggleY) * gain

			local sVal = math.max(sUse, 0.05)
			local sBase = math.clamp(sVal, 0.05, 1)
			local sBoost = math.max(sVal - 1, 0)
			local sm = 1 - (1 - sBase) ^ (dt * 60)
			local lockMul = 1 + sBoost * 1.35
			desiredX = desiredX * sm * lockMul
			desiredY = desiredY * sm * lockMul

			local resp = 1 - math.exp(-C.response * dt)
			stepX = stepX + (desiredX - stepX) * resp
			stepY = stepY + (desiredY - stepY) * resp

			if dist < 6 then
				stepX = stepX * 0.55
				stepY = stepY * 0.55
			end

			local mag = math.sqrt(stepX * stepX + stepY * stepY)
			if mag > C.maxStep and mag > 0 then
				local s = C.maxStep / mag
				stepX, stepY = stepX * s, stepY * s
			end

			if now < stopUntil then
				stepX, stepY = stepX * 0.15, stepY * 0.15
			end

			accX = accX + stepX
			accY = accY + stepY
			local mx = (accX >= 0) and math.floor(accX) or math.ceil(accX)
			local my = (accY >= 0) and math.floor(accY) or math.ceil(accY)
			if mx ~= 0 or my ~= 0 then
				mousemoverel(mx, my)
				accX = accX - mx
				accY = accY - my
			end
		end
	end

	local canTrig = C.trigEnabled
	if C.trigHoldOnlyAim then
		canTrig = canTrig and aiming
	end
	local onTarget = target and dist <= C.trigRadius

	if canTrig and onTarget and (now - trigStart) >= C.trigDelay then
		if C.trigMode == "Hold" then
			if not trigHolding then
				mouseDown()
				trigHolding = true
			end
		else
			if trigHolding then
				mouseUp()
				trigHolding = false
			end
			local interval = 1 / math.max(C.trigCps, 1)
			if now >= nextClick then
				clickOnce()
				nextClick = now + interval
			end
		end
	else
		if trigHolding then
			mouseUp()
			trigHolding = false
		end
	end
end))

D9.Funcs.CreateHover = function(button)
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    local hoverFrame = Instance.new("Frame", button)
    hoverFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    hoverFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hoverFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hoverFrame.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
    Instance.new("UICorner", hoverFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92}):Play() end)
    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play() end)
    button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() 
        pcall(function() local snd = Instance.new("Sound", D9.Core.Snd); snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6895079853"; snd.Volume = 0.3; snd:Play(); game.Debris:AddItem(snd, 1) end)
        D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.8}):Play()
        D9.Core.TS:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.new(button.Size.X.Scale, button.Size.X.Offset - 2, button.Size.Y.Scale, button.Size.Y.Offset - 2)}):Play() 
    end)
    button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() 
        D9.Core.TS:Create(hoverFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.92}):Play()
        D9.Core.TS:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce), {Size = UDim2.new(button.Size.X.Scale, button.Size.X.Offset + 2, button.Size.Y.Scale, button.Size.Y.Offset + 2)}):Play() 
    end)
end

local function AddTab(name, icon, color, isFirst, order)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", D9.UI.SidebarScroll)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30); btn.BackgroundColor3 = isFirst and color or D9.Theme.ButtonBase
    btn.Text = icon .. "  " .. name; btn.TextColor3 = D9.Theme.TextWhite; btn.TextSize = 11
    btn.LayoutOrder = order; btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; btn.ZIndex = 25
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", btn); pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn); s.Color = isFirst and color or D9.Theme.Stroke; s.Transparency = isFirst and 0.2 or 0.8
    D9.Funcs.RegisterText(btn); D9.Funcs.CreateHover(btn)
    
    local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", D9.UI.ContentArea)
    sf.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1; sf.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    sf.ScrollBarThickness = 2; sf.ScrollBarImageColor3 = color; sf.Visible = isFirst; sf.ZIndex = 25
    
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", sf)
    lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8); lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center; lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    lay:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, lay.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 30) end)
    
    local fpad = Instance.new("UIPadding", sf); fpad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10); fpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)
    
    local secTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", sf)
    secTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
    secTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    secTitle.Text = icon .. " " .. name
    secTitle.TextColor3 = color
    secTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    secTitle.TextSize = 20
    secTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    secTitle.LayoutOrder = -999 
    secTitle.ZIndex = 26
    D9.Funcs.RegisterText(secTitle)
    
    table.insert(D9.UI.TabBtns, btn); table.insert(D9.UI.TabCnts, {frame = sf, color = color})
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for i, b in ipairs(D9.UI.TabBtns) do
            local sel = (b == btn)
            D9.UI.TabCnts[i].frame.Visible = sel
            D9.Core.TS:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = sel and D9.UI.TabCnts[i].color or D9.Theme.ButtonBase}):Play()
            b.UIStroke.Color = sel and D9.UI.TabCnts[i].color or D9.Theme.Stroke; b.UIStroke.Transparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.8
        end
    end)
    return sf
end

D9.Funcs.AutoWlk = function(pos)
    local c = D9.Core.Player.Character; if not c then return end; local h = c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"); local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not h or not hrp then return end
    local p = D9.Core.Pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true})
    pcall(function() p:ComputeAsync(hrp.Position, pos) end)
    if p.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local wps = p:GetWaypoints(); D9.Config.AIWalking = true
        task.spawn(function()
            for i = 1, #wps - 1 do local w1 = wps[i].Position; local w2 = wps[i+1].Position; local d = (w1 - w2).Magnitude; local l = Instance.new("Part", workspace); l.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, d); l.CFrame = CFrame.new(w1, w2) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -d/2); l.Anchored = true; l.CanCollide = false; l.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; l.Color = D9.Theme.AccentCyan; table.insert(D9.Cache.VisualPath, l) end
            for _, wp in ipairs(wps) do if not D9.Config.AIWalking then break end; if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump = true end; h:MoveTo(wp.Position); h.MoveToFinished:Wait() end
            D9.Config.AIWalking = false; D9.Funcs.AddMsg("System", L("Маршрут завершен.", "Route finished."), D9.Theme.AccentGreen); for _, l in ipairs(D9.Cache.VisualPath) do l:Destroy() end; D9.Cache.VisualPath = {}
        end)
    else D9.UI.CPrF.Visible = true end
end

D9.Funcs.PAICmd = function(t)
    t = string.lower(t)
    if string.find(t, "привет") or string.find(t, "hello") then return L("Привет! Напиши 'команды'.", "Hi! Type 'commands'.")
    elseif string.find(t, "кто ты") or string.find(t, "who") then return L("Я Deskret9 AI. Управляю читами и строю лазерные пути.", "I am Deskret9 AI. I manage cheats and build laser paths.")
    elseif string.find(t, "совет") or string.find(t, "tip") then return D9.DB.Tips[math.random(1, #D9.DB.Tips)]
    elseif string.find(t, "команд") or string.find(t, "command") then return L("Команды: 'вкл полет', 'выкл полет', 'вкл есп', 'выкл есп', 'иди к [имя]', 'сделай день', 'очисти чат', 'стоп'.", "Commands: 'fly on/off', 'esp on/off', 'go to [name]', 'day time', 'clear chat', 'stop'.")
    elseif string.find(t, "полет") or string.find(t, "fly") then if string.find(t, "вкл") or string.find(t, "on") then D9.Funcs.TogFly(true); return L("Полет активирован.", "Fly ON.") elseif string.find(t, "вык") or string.find(t, "off") then D9.Funcs.TogFly(false); return L("Полет отключен.", "Fly OFF.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "есп") or string.find(t, "esp") then if string.find(t, "вкл") or string.find(t, "on") then D9.Funcs.TogEspM(true); return L("ESP включен.", "ESP ON.") elseif string.find(t, "вык") or string.find(t, "off") then D9.Funcs.TogEspM(false); return L("ESP отключен.", "ESP OFF.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "сделай день") or string.find(t, "day") then pcall(function() D9.Core.Lighting.ClockTime = 12 end); return L("Время установлено на день.", "Set to day time.")
    elseif string.find(t, "очисти чат") or string.find(t, "clear") then for _, c in ipairs(D9.UI.CDs:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end end; return L("Чат очищен.", "Chat cleared.")
    elseif string.find(t, "иди к") or string.find(t, "go to") then local tn = string.match(t, "иди к (%S+)") or string.match(t, "go to (%S+)"); local fP = nil; for _, p in ipairs(D9.Core.Players:GetPlayers()) do if string.lower(string.sub(p.Name, 1, #tn)) == tn or string.lower(string.sub(p.DisplayName, 1, #tn)) == tn then fP = p; break end end; if fP and fP.Character and fP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then D9.Funcs.AutoWalkTo(fP.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position); return L("Прокладываю маршрут к ", "Routing to ") .. fP.Name else return L("Не смог найти игрока.", "Player not found.") end
    elseif string.find(t, "стоп") or string.find(t, "stop") then D9.Config.AIWalking = false; for _, l in ipairs(D9.Cache.VisualPath) do l:Destroy() end; D9.Cache.VisualPath = {}; return L("Остановлено.", "Stopped.") end
    return L("Напиши 'команды', чтобы увидеть список.", "Type 'commands' for a list.")
end

    if gp or D9.Core.UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil then return end
    D9.Cache.KeysDown[i.KeyCode] = true
    local k = i.KeyCode
    if k == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or k == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift or k == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then D9.Funcs.ToggleMinimize()
    elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.E then D9.Funcs.TogFly()
    elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Q then D9.Funcs.TogCam("Drone")
    elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.X then D9.Funcs.TogCam("Spectator")
    elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.N then D9.Funcs.TogNcl()

end)

local fCnt, lTk = 0, tick()
D9.Core.RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    fCnt = fCnt + 1; if tick() - lTk >= 0.5 then local fps = math.floor(fCnt / (tick() - lTk)); pcall(function() D9.UI.Stats.Text = "FPS: " .. fps .. " | PING: " .. string.split(tostring(D9.Core.Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()), ".")[1] .. "ms" end); fCnt = 0; lTk = tick() end

    if D9.Config.ESP then
        for _, p in ipairs(D9.Core.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= D9.Core.Player and p.Character then
                local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if hrp and hum then
                    if D9.Config.ESPNames then
                        local tag = D9.UI.ESPFolder:FindFirstChild("T_" .. p.Name)
                        if not tag then tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui", D9.UI.ESPFolder); tag.Name = "T_" .. p.Name; tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40); tag.AlwaysOnTop = true; tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0); local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", tag); tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0; tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; tl.TextSize = 12 end
                        tag.Adornee = hrp; tag.TextLabel.Text = p.Name .. "\n[" .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. " HP]"; tag.TextLabel.TextColor3 = hum.Health > 50 and D9.Theme.AccentGreen or D9.Theme.AccentRed; tag.Enabled = true
                    else local tag = D9.UI.ESPFolder:FindFirstChild("T_" .. p.Name); if tag then tag.Enabled = false end end
                    
                    if D9.Config.ESPBoxes then
                        local h = D9.UI.ESPFolder:FindFirstChild("H_" .. p.Name)
                        if not h then h = Instance.new("Highlight", D9.UI.ESPFolder); h.Name = "H_" .. p.Name; h.FillColor = D9.Theme.AccentRed; h.OutlineColor = D9.Theme.TextWhite; h.FillTransparency = 0.5; h.OutlineTransparency = 0 end
                        h.Adornee = p.Character; h.Enabled = true
                    else local h = D9.UI.ESPFolder:FindFirstChild("H_" .. p.Name); if h then h.Enabled = false end end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local bst = IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) or IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift); local spd = bst and (D9.Config.FlySpeed * 2.2) or D9.Config.FlySpeed
    if D9.Config.IsFlying and D9.Cache.FlyObj.Velocity and D9.Cache.FlyObj.Align then
        local m = Vector3.zero; local lk = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame.LookVector; local rt = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.W) then m += lk end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.S) then m -= lk end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.D) then m += rt end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.A) then m -= rt end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then m += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then m -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        D9.Cache.FlyObj.Align.CFrame = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame
        if m.Magnitude > 0 then
            D9.Cache.FlyObj.Velocity.VectorVelocity = m.Unit * spd
            if bst and D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost and not D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost.IsPlaying then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost:Play(0.2); if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward:Stop(0.2) end; if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover:Stop(0.2) end
            elseif not bst and D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward and not D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward.IsPlaying then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward:Play(0.2); if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost:Stop(0.2) end; if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover:Stop(0.2) end end
        else
            D9.Cache.FlyObj.Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Boost:Stop(0.2) end; if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Forward:Stop(0.2) end; if D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover and not D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover.IsPlaying then D9.Cache.AnimTracks.Hover:Play(0.2) end
        end
    end
    
    if D9.Config.CamMode ~= "None" and D9.Cache.FlyObj.DroneVel and D9.Cache.FlyObj.DroneAlign then
        local m = Vector3.zero; local lk = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame.LookVector; local rt = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.W) then m += lk end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.S) then m -= lk end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.D) then m += rt end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.A) then m -= rt end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then m += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end; if IsKD(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then m -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        D9.Cache.FlyObj.DroneAlign.CFrame = D9.Core.Camera.CFrame; if m.Magnitude > 0 then D9.Cache.FlyObj.DroneVel.VectorVelocity = m.Unit * spd else D9.Cache.FlyObj.DroneVel.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero end
    end
    
    if D9.Cache.SpeedObj.HaloWeld and D9.Cache.SpeedObj.HaloWeld.Parent and not D9.Config.IsAwakened then D9.Cache.SpeedObj.HaloWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.0 + (math.sin(tick() * 4) * 0.15), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0) end
    if D9.Config.EnforceSpeed and D9.Core.Player.Character and not D9.Config.IsAwakened then local hum = D9.Core.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"); if hum then hum.UseJumpPower = true; hum.WalkSpeed = D9.Config.WalkSpeed; hum.JumpPower = D9.Config.JumpPower end end
end)

scripts.features:
🌟 Deskret9 Hub Pro - Feature List 🌟
🤖 AI & Automation

Smart AI Assistant: Interactive chatbot that responds to your questions and executes commands.

AI Laser Navigator: Advanced pathfinding system that draws a neon laser path and auto-walks you to any player on the server.

Smart Obstacle Bypass: The AI automatically prompts you to enable Noclip if a path is physically blocked.

🚀 Player & Movement

Advanced Flight System: Smooth flying with adjustable speed.

Custom Flight Animations: 8 unique poses (Superhero, Ninja, Sky Sprint, Omni, Meditation, etc.).

Aura & Trails: Stunning visual speed/flight trails and neon halos (Cyberpunk, Flame, Void, Toxic, Lightning).

Camera Modes: Switch between standard, Drone (Freecam), and Spectator modes while flying.

Movement Modifiers: Enforce custom WalkSpeed and JumpPower.

Noclip: Walk through solid walls and obstacles effortlessly.

👁️ Visuals & ESP

Full ESP Suite: Wallhack with Names, HP, Highlights (Boxes), and Tracers.

X-Ray Vision: Makes all map structures semi-transparent to find secrets.

33+ Custom Shaders: Completely change the game's atmosphere (Infrared, Nuclear Bomb, Synthwave, Cyberpunk, Silent Hill, Matrix, Anime, and more).

💻 Built-in Utilities & Scripting

Integrated ScriptBlox Search: Search the entire ScriptBlox database from inside the game. Execute or copy scripts in one click.

Auto-Game Search: Instantly find scripts for the game you are currently playing.

Multi-Tab IDE: A built-in code editor/executor with support for multiple script tabs.

FPS Boosters: Instantly disable shadows or activate "Potato Mode" (remove textures/materials) for maximum performance.

🔥 Exclusive Features

Ultimate Awakening Ability: A massive visual explosion with custom FOV, screen shakes, aura effects, and sounds.

Teleport Hub: Built-in catalog of 80+ most popular Roblox games with instant server teleportation.

Premium Customization: Beautiful Sidebar UI, multi-language support (EN/RU), customizable fonts, and background wallpapers.

Anti-Cheat Guide: Integrated tips and tricks to avoid getting banned or kicked.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- GUI SETUP
--==================================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ClientAudioControl"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "MainFrame"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -195)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
frame.Parent = screenGui

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "Title"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "FE Audio Controller GUI"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 22
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
titleLabel.Parent = frame

--==================================================
-- RESPECT FILTERING ENABLED LABEL
--==================================================
local filteringLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
filteringLabel.Name = "RespectFilteringEnabled"
filteringLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
filteringLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
filteringLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
filteringLabel.TextSize = 18
filteringLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
filteringLabel.Parent = frame

--==================================================
-- RESPECT FILTERING NOTIFICATION GENERATOR
--==================================================
local debounce = false
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function runWarningNotification()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true

    -- Create the dynamic Warning TextLabel
    local warningLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    warningLabel.Name = "FilteringWarningNotification"
    warningLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 80)
    warningLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) -- Starts off-screen right
    warningLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    warningLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    warningLabel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    warningLabel.BorderSizePixel = 3
    warningLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    warningLabel.TextSize = 14
    warningLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
    warningLabel.TextWrapped = true
    warningLabel.Text = "RespectFilteringEnabled is enabled so this means this script will be fully visual and check the script description for more info!"
    warningLabel.Parent = screenGui

    -- Slide In Animation
    local slideIn = TweenService:Create(warningLabel, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)})
    slideIn:Play()
    slideIn.Completed:Wait()

    -- Display Hold Time
    task.wait(8)

    -- Slide Out Animation
    local slideOut = TweenService:Create(warningLabel, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(1, 450, 0.1, 0)})
    slideOut:Play()
    slideOut.Completed:Wait()

    -- Cleanup
    warningLabel:Destroy()
    debounce = false
end

local function updateFilteringLabel()
    local value = SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled
    filteringLabel.Text = "RespectFilteringEnabled = " .. tostring(value)
    
    if value then
        filteringLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- TRUE = RED
    else
        filteringLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- FALSE = GREEN
    end
end

updateFilteringLabel()

-- Add these 3 lines here so it only triggers once on startup:
if SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled then
    task.spawn(runWarningNotification)
end

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION
--==================================================
local function createButton(name, text, yPosition)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPosition)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 3
    button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
    button.Parent = frame
    return button
end

local playButton   = createButton("PlayAllButton", "Play All", 82)
local stopButton   = createButton("StopAllButton", "Stop All", 128)
local pauseButton  = createButton("PauseAllButton", "Pause All", 174)
local loopButton   = createButton("LoopButton", "Loop All", 220)
local spamButton   = createButton("SpamButton", "Spam All", 266)
local lockButton   = createButton("LockButton", "Loop Stop All", 312)

--==================================================
-- SOUND FUNCTIONS
--==================================================
local function getAllSounds()
    local sounds = {}
    for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(sounds, object)
        end
    end
    return sounds
end

local savedPositions = {}

local function stopAllSounds()
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound:Stop()
    end
end

-- BUTTON 1: PLAY ALL
playButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound:Play()
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 2: STOP ALL
stopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    stopAllSounds()
end)

-- BUTTON 3: PAUSE / RESUME
local paused = false
pauseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not paused then
        savedPositions = {}
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            savedPositions[sound] = sound.TimePosition
            sound:Stop()
        end
        paused = true
        pauseButton.Text = "Unpause All"
    else
        for sound, position in pairs(savedPositions) do
            if sound and sound.Parent and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                sound.TimePosition = position
                sound:Play()
            end
        end
        paused = false
        pauseButton.Text = "Pause All"
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 4: TOGGLE LOOPED
local loopEnabled = false
loopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loopEnabled = not loopEnabled
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound.Looped = loopEnabled
    end
    loopButton.Text = loopEnabled and "Unloop All" or "Loop All"
end)

-- BUTTON 5: SPAM ALL AUDIOS
local spamEnabled = false
local function spamSounds()
    while spamEnabled do
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            sound:Play()
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
        if not spamEnabled then break end
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            sound:Stop()
        end
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end

spamButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    spamEnabled = not spamEnabled
    if spamEnabled then
        spamButton.Text = "Unspam All"
        task.spawn(spamSounds)
    else
        spamButton.Text = "Spam All"
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 6: PERSISTENT STOP
local persistentStop = false
local persistentConnection
local function startPersistentStop()
    if persistentConnection then persistentConnection:Disconnect() end
    persistentConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not persistentStop then return end
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            if sound.IsPlaying then
                sound:Stop()
            end
        end
    end)
end

lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    persistentStop = not persistentStop
    if persistentStop then
        lockButton.Text = "Unloop Stop All"
        stopAllSounds()
        startPersistentStop()
    else
        lockButton.Text = "Loop Stop All"
        if persistentConnection then
            persistentConnection:Disconnect()
            persistentConnection = nil
        end
    end
end)

-- DETECT NEW SOUNDS
game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
    if object:IsA("Sound") and persistentStop then
        task.defer(function()
            if object.Parent and persistentStop then
                object:Stop()
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- KEEP FILTERING LABEL UPDATED
task.spawn(function()
    while screenGui.Parent do
        updateFilteringLabel()
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

-- LocalScript
-- StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Einstellungen
local AIM_ENABLED = false
local AIM_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.Q

local FOV_RADIUS = 150
local MAX_DISTANCE = 500
local SMOOTHNESS = 0.15

--------------------------------------------------
-- FOV Kreis
--------------------------------------------------

local circle = Drawing.new("Circle")
circle.Visible = true
circle.Radius = FOV_RADIUS
circle.Thickness = 2
circle.NumSides = 64
circle.Filled = false
circle.Transparency = 1

--------------------------------------------------
-- FOV Position aktualisieren
--------------------------------------------------

local function updateFOV()
	circle.Position = Vector2.new(
		camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
		camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
	)

	circle.Radius = FOV_RADIUS
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- Wallcheck
--------------------------------------------------

local function canSeeTarget(targetPart)
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = targetPart.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		player.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(
		origin,
		direction,
		params
	)

	if not result then
		return true
	end

	return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- Bestes Ziel finden
--------------------------------------------------

local function getClosestTarget()
	local center = Vector2.new(
		camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
		camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
	)

	local closestTarget = nil
	local closestDistance = FOV_RADIUS

	for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		if target ~= player and target.Character then

			local character = target.Character
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoid and head and root and humanoid.Health > 0 then

				local distance =
					(root.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

				if distance <= MAX_DISTANCE then

					local screenPosition, onScreen =
						camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)

					if onScreen then

						local screenDistance =
							(Vector2.new(
								screenPosition.X,
								screenPosition.Y
							) - center).Magnitude

						if screenDistance < closestDistance then

							if canSeeTarget(head) then
								closestDistance = screenDistance
								closestTarget = head
							end

						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestTarget
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- Aim
--------------------------------------------------

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

	updateFOV()

	circle.Visible = AIM_ENABLED

	if not AIM_ENABLED then
		return
	end

	local target = getClosestTarget()

	if target then

		local cameraPosition = camera.CFrame.Position

		local targetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
			cameraPosition,
			target.Position
		)

		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(
			targetCFrame,
			SMOOTHNESS
		)
	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- Aktivieren / Deaktivieren
--------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

	if processed then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == AIM_KEY then
		AIM_ENABLED = not AIM_ENABLED
	end
end)

scripts.script:
local P=game:GetService("Players")
local W=game:GetService("Workspace")
local U=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local R=game:GetService("RunService")
local C=game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LP=P.LocalPlayer
local CAM=workspace.CurrentCamera

local AB=false
local E1=false
local E2=false
local E3=false
local H1=false
local B1=false
local H2=false

local FN=20
local FF=400
local PN=320
local PF=160
local TC=false
local CT=nil
local CD=0
local CC=Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)
local FT=0.5
local OT=0.3
local SM=0.2
local PR=true

local AE={}
local PD={}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- FAST SPAWN PIPELINE
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local eQlist={}
local eQset={}
local eQscheduled=false

local function gF(d)
    if d<=FN then return PN end
    if d>=FF then return PF end
    local t=(d-FN)/(FF-FN)
    t=t*t
    return PN+(PF-PN)*t
end

local DK={door=true,window=true,wall=true,floor=true,ceiling=true,prop=true,decoration=true,furniture=true,stairs=true,railing=true,pipe=true,vent=true,crate=true,barrel=true,container=true}

local function hN(n)
    n=n:lower()
    for w in pairs(DK) do if string.find(n,w,1,true) then return true end end
    return false
end

local function iD(m)
    if hN(m.Name) then return true end
    local p=m.Parent
    local d=0
    while p and d<4 do
        local n=p.Name
        if n=="activemap" or n=="map" or n=="decor" or n=="decorations" then return true end
        if hN(n) then return true end
        p=p.Parent
        d=d+1
    end
    return false
end

local function iSB(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return false end
    if not m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return false end
    return true
end

local function iCM(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return false end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return true end
    if iD(m) then return false end
    if m:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return true end
    local hH=m:FindFirstChild("Head")~=nil
    local hA=m:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")~=nil
    if (hH or hA) and (m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart) then return true end
    local n=m.Name:lower()
    if (string.find(n,"character",1,true) or string.find(n,"player",1,true) or string.find(n,"bot",1,true)) and (m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart) then return true end
    return false
end

local function gT(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return nil end
    local pl=P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
    if pl then return "player",pl end
    if iSB(m) then return "bot",m end
    if iCM(m) then return "custom",m end
    return nil
end

local function gN(m,t,r)
    if t=="player" and r then return r.Name end
    if t=="bot" and r then return r.Name or "Bot" end
    if t=="custom" and r then return r.Name or "Model" end
    return m.Name or "?"
end

local function gB(m)
    local p=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
    if p then return p end
    for _,c in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") then return c end end
    return nil
end

local function cB(m,n)
    local p=gB(m)
    if not p then return nil end
    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,200,0,50)
    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
    bb.Parent=p
    local tl=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    tl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    tl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    tl.Text=n
    tl.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
    tl.TextSize=10
    tl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tl.TextStrokeTransparency=0.5
    tl.Parent=bb
    return bb
end

local function aE(m,t,r)
    if PD[m] or AE[m] then return end
    PD[m]=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local n=gN(m,t,r)
        if not m.Parent then PD[m]=nil return end
        local hl=Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.FillColor=CC
        hl.OutlineColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        hl.FillTransparency=FT
        hl.OutlineTransparency=OT
        hl.Adornee=m
        hl.Parent=m
        local bb=cB(m,n)
        AE[m]={hl,bb}
        PD[m]=nil
    end)
end

local function rE(m)
    local d=AE[m]
    if d then
        if d[1] then d[1]:Destroy() end
        if d[2] then d[2]:Destroy() end
        AE[m]=nil
    end
    PD[m]=nil
end

local function cA()
    for m in pairs(AE) do rE(m) end
end

local function uC()
    for _,d in pairs(AE) do
        if d and d[1] then
            d[1].FillColor=CC
            d[1].FillTransparency=FT
            d[1].OutlineTransparency=OT
        end
    end
end

function pM(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return end
    local t,r=gT(m)
    if not t then
        if AE[m] then rE(m) end
        return
    end
    local en=false
    if t=="player" and E1 then en=true
    elseif t=="bot" and E2 then en=true
    elseif t=="custom" and E3 then en=true
    end
    if not en then
        if AE[m] then rE(m) end
        return
    end
    local ex=AE[m]
    if ex then
        local hl,bb=ex[1],ex[2]
        local br=(not hl or not hl.Parent)
        if not br and bb then
            local p=bb.Parent
            if not p or not p:IsDescendantOf(m) then br=true end
        end
        if not br then return end
        rE(m)
    end
    aE(m,t,r)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- AIM CACHE (set-based for O(1))
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CP={}
local CB={}
local CBset={}
local CM={}
local CMset={}
local AR=false

local function rP()
    local n={}
    for _,pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl~=LP and pl.Character then
            local ch=pl.Character
            local rt=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rt then
                local ap=rt
                if H1 then
                    local hd=ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if hd then ap=hd end
                end
                n[#n+1]={aimPart=ap,type="player",ref=pl,model=ch}
            end
        end
    end
    CP=n
end

local function aSB(m)
    if not B1 then return end
    if not m or not m.Parent then return end
    local e=CBset[m]
    if e then
        if e.aimPart and e.aimPart.Parent then return end
        local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local ap=root
        if H2 then
            local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
        end
        e.aimPart=ap
        return
    end
    if not iSB(m) then return end
    local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local ap=root
    if H2 then
        local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
    end
    local entry={aimPart=ap,type="bot",ref=m,model=m}
    CB[#CB+1]=entry
    CBset[m]=entry
end

local function rSB(m)
    local e=CBset[m]
    if not e then return end
    CBset[m]=nil
    for i=1,#CB do if CB[i]==e then table.remove(CB,i) break end end
end

local function aCM(m)
    if not B1 or not E3 then return end
    if not m or not m.Parent then return end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return end
    local e=CMset[m]
    if e then
        if e.aimPart and e.aimPart.Parent then return end
        local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
        if not root then return end
        e.aimPart=root
        if H2 then
            local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("head")
            if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then e.aimPart=hd end
        end
        return
    end
    if not iCM(m) then return end
    local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end
    local ap=root
    if H2 then
        local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("head")
        if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
    end
    local entry={aimPart=ap,type="custom",ref=m,model=m}
    CM[#CM+1]=entry
    CMset[m]=entry
end

local function rCM(m)
    local e=CMset[m]
    if not e then return end
    CMset[m]=nil
    for i=1,#CM do if CM[i]==e then table.remove(CM,i) break end end
end

local function rA()
    if AR then return end
    AR=true
    task.spawn(function()
        rP()
        local nb={}
        local nbs={}
        if B1 then
            local l=W:GetDescendants()
            local b=120
            for i=1,#l,b do
                local s=math.min(i+b-1,#l)
                for j=i,s do
                    local o=l[j]
                    if o:IsA("Model") and iSB(o) then
                        local root=o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if root then
                            local ap=root
                            if H2 then
                                local hd=o:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                            end
                            local entry={aimPart=ap,type="bot",ref=o,model=o}
                            nb[#nb+1]=entry
                            nbs[o]=entry
                        end
                    end
                end
                R.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        CB=nb
        CBset=nbs
        local nc={}
        local ncs={}
        if B1 and E3 then
            local l=W:GetDescendants()
            local b=120
            for i=1,#l,b do
                local s=math.min(i+b-1,#l)
                for j=i,s do
                    local o=l[j]
                    if o:IsA("Model") and not P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(o) and iCM(o) then
                        local root=o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or o.PrimaryPart
                        if root then
                            local ap=root
                            if H2 then
                                local hd=o:FindFirstChild("Head") or o:FindFirstChild("head")
                                if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                            end
                            local entry={aimPart=ap,type="custom",ref=o,model=o}
                            nc[#nc+1]=entry
                            ncs[o]=entry
                        end
                    end
                end
                R.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        CM=nc
        CMset=ncs
        AR=false
    end)
end

-- UNIFIED HANDLER: ESP + AIM в одном проходе
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function handleNew(o)
    if not o or not o.Parent then return end
    local m
    if o:IsA("Model") then
        m=o
    elseif o:IsA("Humanoid") or o:IsA("BasePart") then
        m=o.Parent
        if not m or not m:IsA("Model") then return end
    else
        return
    end
    if E1 or E2 or E3 then pM(m) end
    if B1 then aSB(m) aCM(m) end
end

local function eQ(o)
    if eQset[o] then return end
    eQset[o]=true
    eQlist[#eQlist+1]=o
    if eQscheduled then return end
    eQscheduled=true
    task.defer(function()
        eQscheduled=false
        local items=eQlist
        eQlist={}
        eQset={}
        for i=1,#items do
            handleNew(items[i])
        end
    end)
end

local function sT()
    W.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if not (E1 or E2 or E3 or B1) then return end
        local cn=o.ClassName
        if cn=="Model" or cn=="Humanoid" or cn=="BasePart" or cn=="MeshPart" then
            eQ(o)
        end
    end)
    W.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(o)
        if o:IsA("Model") then
            if AE[o] then rE(o) end
            rSB(o)
            rCM(o)
        elseif o:IsA("Humanoid") then
            local m=o.Parent
            if m and m:IsA("Model") then
                if AE[m] then rE(m) end
                rSB(m)
                rCM(m)
            end
        end
    end)
end

    P.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)

        pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)

            task.defer(function()

                end
            end)

        pl.CharacterRemoving:Connect(rP)

    P.PlayerRemoving:Connect(rP)

                if ch and ch.Parent then

end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ESP REFRESH (batched)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local FS=false
local RQ=false

local function rF()
    if not E1 and not E2 and not E3 then cA() return end
    if FS then RQ=true return end
    FS=true
    task.spawn(function()
        for _,pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
            if pl~=LP and pl.Character then pM(pl.Character) end
        end
        local hs={}
        local ms={}
        for _,o in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
            if o:IsA("Humanoid") then hs[#hs+1]=o
            elseif o:IsA("Model") then ms[#ms+1]=o end
        end
        local tot=#hs
        local i=1
        while i<=tot do
            local s=math.min(i+59,tot)
            for j=i,s do
                local m=hs[j].Parent
                if m and m:IsA("Model") then pM(m) end
            end
            i=s+1
            if i<=tot then R.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        end
        tot=#ms
        i=1
        while i<=tot do
            local s=math.min(i+79,tot)
            for j=i,s do pM(ms[j]) end
            i=s+1
            if i<=tot then R.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        end
        FS=false
        if RQ then RQ=false rF() end
    end)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- AIM TARGETING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function gCT()
    local cl=nil
    local bs=math.huge
    local vp=CAM.ViewportSize
    local cx,cy=vp.X/2,vp.Y/2
    local ch=LP.Character
    local rt=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local pp=rt and rt.Position or CAM.CFrame.Position
    local tg={}
    for i=#CP,1,-1 do
        local t=CP[i]
        if not t.aimPart or not t.aimPart.Parent then table.remove(CP,i)
        else tg[#tg+1]=t end
    end
    if B1 then
        for m,e in pairs(CBset) do
            if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rSB(m)
            else tg[#tg+1]=e end
        end
        if E3 then
            for m,e in pairs(CMset) do
                if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rCM(m)
                else tg[#tg+1]=e end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,t in ipairs(tg) do
        local ap=t.aimPart
        local pos=ap.Position
        local sp,os=CAM:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
        if os then
            local dx,dy=sp.X-cx,sp.Y-cy
            local ds=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
            local ddx,ddy,ddz=pp.X-pos.X,pp.Y-pos.Y,pp.Z-pos.Z
            local wd=math.sqrt(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy+ddz*ddz)
            local ef=gF(wd)
            if ds<=ef then
                local sc=ds+wd*0.04
                if sc<bs then
                    bs=sc
                    cl=t
                    CD=wd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

local function lT()
    if CT and CT.aimPart and CT.aimPart.Parent then
        local ap=CT.aimPart
        local tp=ap.Position
        if PR then
            local v=ap.Velocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            local pd=math.clamp(0.05+(CD/2000),0.02,0.1)
            tp=tp+(v*pd)
        end
        CAM.CFrame=CAM.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(CAM.CFrame.Position,tp),SM)
    else
        CT=nil
    end
end

        if not CT or not CT.aimPart or not CT.aimPart.Parent then CT=gCT() end
        if CT then lT() end
    else

end)

local function mkSlider(parent,y,label,mn,mx,ini,cb,fillColor)
    local row=mkRow(parent,y,label)
    local track=Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size=UDim2.new(0,110,0,4)
    track.Position=UDim2.new(1,-110,0.5,-2)
    track.BackgroundColor3=TRACK_OFF
    track.BorderSizePixel=0
    track.Parent=row
    Instance.new("UICorner",track).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local rel=(ini-mn)/(mx-mn)
    local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size=UDim2.new(rel,0,1,0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3=fillColor or ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel=0
    fill.Parent=track
    Instance.new("UICorner",fill).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local knob=Instance.new("TextButton")
    knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,10,0,10)
    knob.Position=UDim2.new(rel,-5,0.5,-5)
    knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,240,245)
    knob.BorderSizePixel=0
    knob.Text=""
    knob.AutoButtonColor=false
    knob.Parent=track
    Instance.new("UICorner",knob).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local dg=false
    local function upd(ip)
        local rx=ip.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local w=track.AbsoluteSize.X
        local v=math.clamp(rx/w,0,1)*(mx-mn)+mn
        v=math.round(v*100)/100
        local rv=(v-mn)/(mx-mn)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(rv,0,1,0)
        knob.Position=UDim2.new(rv,-5,0.5,-5)
        cb(v)
    end
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dg=true upd(inp.Position) end
    end)
    U.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if dg and inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(inp.Position) end
    end)
    U.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dg=false end
    end)
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then upd(inp.Position) dg=true end
    end)
    return fill,knob
end
